title: Housekeeping: SECURITY/README drift and root DECISIONS sync
objective: Remove documentation drift that misstates the security model: align SECURITY.md and README with actual compose defaults, and replace or sync the stale root DECISIONS.md so there is one live decision log. Enforcement of .mester-egress allowed_domains lives in the workspace Docker ticket.

acceptance_criteria.text: SECURITY.md matches compose.yaml: egress default, mem_limit 8g, no host ports, capabilities, and the Docker-in-VM access model once #42 defines it.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: SECURITY.md rewritten against compose.yaml: §2 records egress enabled by default ([egress, internal]), --isolated / .mester-egress permission=false, setup-only pull egress, no published ports, and that allowed_domains is parsed but not yet enforced (#43). §3 keeps the single workspace mount and adds the target virtiofs export plus the no-host-Docker-socket rule. §4 records rootless Docker inside the VM (#42) and the no-privileged-container override. §5 states mem_limit 8g and pids_limit 512. The Docker-in-VM target is docs/DECISIONS.md §C.8 and docs/vm-architecture.md.
acceptance_criteria.note: The target access model is recorded; #42 implements and tests it. This ticket fixes the documentation drift.

acceptance_criteria.text: README matches the same facts and the VM workflow; no 'no internet by default' or '4g' claim remains unless it is true.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: README.md intro no longer says "No internet by default"; it states egress is enabled by default and --isolated removes it. A "VM harness status (epic #35, in progress)" section points at docs/vm-architecture.md and says host Docker is still the current mode. The architecture diagram is labelled current mode; the egress table, security table (8g/512), design-decision row, troubleshooting and Docker-group note now match compose/C.8. Stale "4g", "egress is opt-in" and "internet off at runtime" claims are gone and the drift check enforces that.
acceptance_criteria.note: The full VM provisioning runbook remains #41 A8; this ticket corrects the current facts and labels the target.

acceptance_criteria.text: Root DECISIONS.md is either a thin pointer to docs/DECISIONS.md or a verified synced copy; DECISION-011 references point to existing ticket/file numbers, and a link check passes.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Root DECISIONS.md is now a thin pointer to docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/tickets/architecture/DECISIONS.md. The former 12-entry log is frozen at docs/tickets/archive/root-decisions-v1-2026-10-21.md with a banner saying it is not current guidance; DECISION-011 links were repaired to ../ticket-014.json and ../ticket-015.json (the old ticket-014-docker-in-docker-failure.md and ticket-015-agent-security-modes.md files did not exist).

acceptance_criteria.text: A repeatable check (script or bats test) fails when SECURITY.md/README drift from compose defaults again, or the check is explicitly added to verify-lab.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/check-docs-consistency.py parses the compose agent service (mem_limit, pids_limit, networks, read_only, cap_drop, no-new-privileges), compares SECURITY.md/README.md, rejects the known stale claims, verifies the root DECISIONS pointer, and checks local markdown links + conflict markers. verify-lab.sh calls it before the sandbox checks; bash -n verify-lab.sh passes. The script reports 88/88 checks passing.

acceptance_criteria.text: All links in README, SECURITY.md and both decision logs resolve; no stale paths or conflict markers.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: All local links in README.md, SECURITY.md, root DECISIONS.md, docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/tickets/architecture/DECISIONS.md, docs/vm-architecture.md and the archived root log resolve (same script). No conflict markers in those files. The only pre-existing broken links were the two DECISION-011 paths, now repaired.

created: docs link check (same script: README, SECURITY, both decision logs, root pointer, archive)
verify-lab integration (call added; bash -n passes; full Docker run deferred to #41)
cases: Compose facts mirrored in SECURITY/README: mem_limit 8g, pids_limit 512, [egress, internal], read_only, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges.
Stale claims removed: "No internet by default", "mem_limit: 4g", "Egress is opt-in", "Internet off at runtime", "zero route", "No proxy."
Root DECISIONS.md is a pointer; DECISION-011 archive links resolve to ticket-014.json and ticket-015.json.
Local markdown links and conflict markers checked across README, SECURITY, root/docs/architecture decision logs and the archived log: all resolve.
Full verify-lab run is deferred because this environment has no Docker CLI/daemon; #41 carries the clean-VM run.
